subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should `codexbar cookie refresh` be a general descriptor-driven browser-cookie recovery command, or remain limited to providers with a verified immediate importer and fail without clearing when that importer is unavailable?
rationale: The branch introduces a new authentication-recovery surface rather than repairing an established CLI contract, and its documented fallback can leave users with a cleared cache until a later app refresh.

options.title: Limit to verified immediate importers
options.body: Expose the command only for providers that can complete the signed CLI/app import path and preserve the cache when immediate re-import cannot run.

options.title: Keep descriptor-driven recovery
options.body: Support every descriptor-backed provider, but explicitly document and test the deferred-reimport cache-clearing behavior as the permanent contract.

options.title: Defer the CLI surface
options.body: Keep the existing cache-clear workflow until a broader provider recovery API has a maintainer-approved contract.

recommendation.title: Limit to verified immediate importers
recommendation.body: Expose the command only for providers that can complete the signed CLI/app import path and preserve the cache when immediate re-import cannot run.
